name: Two targets at once -- cybersecurity and software engineering
description: First persona to exercise multi-track merging (step 1 of the design doc's 9-step algorithm, wired 2026-10-20 after it turned out profile.targets[1:] was silently ignored). Three real modules are named by both tracks at different layers -- 'Software Architecture' (cybersecurity nice_to_have, software_engineering core), 'Static Program Analysis' (cybersecurity nice_to_have, software_engineering complementary), and 'Communication Systems Engineering' (cybersecurity complementary, software_engineering nice_to_have) -- a real, three-way test of 'the highest layer wins.' This is also the second persona in the whole suite (after p11) where the area requirement actually comes back satisfied -- merging two tracks genuinely covers 3 areas including theoretical_cs, verified against hand-computed totals before writing this.
